excluded_methods.name: NoobAI XL V-Pred 1.0 drop-in replacement
excluded_methods.reason: Not a drop-in replacement: upstream requires v_prediction, rescaled zero-SNR betas and Euler; existing DPM++ pipeline and epsilon-trained adapters are not validated for it. Upstream prohibits commercialization. No claim of automatic HDR/quality improvement.

excluded_methods.name: Face-derived garment detector
excluded_methods.reason: Implemented only as optional geometry prior and advisory color measurements. It cannot prove garment segmentation, exact motif identity, or pleat counts.
